findings.finding: [fermi_organizer/extraction.py:183] — the Tesseract fallback uses shutil.which("tesseract"), which on Windows searches the current working directory first → a tesseract.exe planted in the launch directory is executed by the version probe and every OCR pass
findings.evidence: TESSERACT_EXE is realpath+isfile validated; the which() result is not; verified shutil.which returns .\tesseract.EXE with a planted file

findings.finding: [fermi_organizer/fsops.py:1161] — the orphan-retirement symlink guard calls opath.is_symlink() instead of the module's _islink() long-path helper → a symlinked parked orphan at a path of 260+ chars reads as not-a-symlink and is compared through and then unlinked
findings.evidence: only remaining .is_symlink() in the package; 8 other sites use _islink; verified LongPathsEnabled=0 behavior

findings.finding: [fermi_organizer/fsops.py:675] — release_run_lock unlinks the lock path without re-reading the token it wrote → a run whose lock was stolen while paused deletes the new holder's live lock and leaves the tree unlocked for a third run
findings.evidence: release_run_lock only stops the heartbeat then unlinks; abandon_run_lock exists for the loss path

findings.finding: [fermi_report_xlsx.py:349] — the run-history sidecar is written through the fixed name <xlsx>.history.json.tmp with write_text and no O_EXCL or islink check → a pre-existing symlink at that name is followed and its target truncated with run-history JSON
findings.evidence: constant staging name at 347; write_text at 349; fsops._staged_copy uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL plus an islink re-check
